title: Chatham Bars Inn Hosts Guild Art Show Feb 22, 3-5pm
paragraphs: The award-winning Chatham Bars Inn ‘Winter Art Series’ is hosting the Guild of Harwich Artists Art Show on Saturday, February 22, from 3pm to 5pm in the ‘Garden Suite’ of the main hotel. bodyHtml:
Michael Rudden February 16, 2025

The award-winning Chatham Bars Inn ‘Winter Art Series’ is hosting the Guild of Harwich Artists Art Show on Saturday, February 22, from 3pm to 5pm in the ‘Garden Suite’ of the main hotel.  This event is free and open to the public. Come join us for a complementary glass of Prosecco and an opportunity to meet the artists.

The art show consists of seventy-five original paintings in various mediums available to purchase at the show.  The paintings include iconic Cape Cod images CBI Art Show Flyer of diverse sizes and price range.
